title: Yesterday
grammar: Simple Past do to be: was / were (afirmativo, wasn't / weren't, Was he…? Were you…?) + there was / there were
today: Hoje você vai aprender a falar do passado com o to be: onde você estava, com quem, e quem foi o culpado da fofoca.
canDo: Dizer onde você estava: I was at home
Negar: I wasn't there / You weren't at my place
Perguntar Where were you? / Were you at home?
Usar last night, yesterday, two days ago, in 2020

video.context: O Daddy Pig está com um carro novo, cheio de tecnologia, que até fala. Aí uma policial para o carro dele…
video.predict: Na sua opinião, o que a policial vai perguntar pro Daddy Pig? E o que ele vai responder?

options: The car was the driver, not Daddy Pig
Daddy Pig's car was at home

lines.text: It's Sunday, 9 AM. Last night, there was a party in apartment 101.
Where were you last night, Tony? Were you at home?
Yes, I was. I was in bed at 10.
There were 20 people in your apartment!
**To be honest**, I wasn't there. I was at Carlos's place.
That's not true! You weren't at my place. I was with Max.
**So** who was it?
**Well**… it was me. Yesterday was my birthday! Tony was the DJ.
I was there. My last party was in 2020, six years ago!

options: There was a party in apartment 101
Jenny tells the truth: it was her party

questions.q: How many people were in Tony's apartment?

chunks.chunk: last night / yesterday / six years ago / in 2020
chunks.pt: ontem à noite / ontem / seis anos atrás / em 2020
chunks.tip: "Ago" vem DEPOIS do tempo: six years ago, two days ago (dois dias atrás). E ano vai com IN: in 2020. Fala-se "twenty twenty"!
examples: My last party was in 2020, six years ago!

practice.pt: Meu aniversário foi dois dias atrás.
practice.en: My birthday was two days ago

alt: My last party was in twenty nineteen

chunks.chunk: To be honest… / That's not true!
chunks.pt: Pra ser sincero… / Isso não é verdade!
chunks.tip: "To be honest" abre a confissão (todo fofoqueiro usa!). E "That's not true!" é pra desmentir na hora.
examples: To be honest, I wasn't there.
That's not true! You weren't at my place.
To be honest, it was me.

practice.pt: Pra ser sincero, eu estava em casa.
practice.en: To be honest, I was at home
To be honest, it was me

chunks.chunk: I was / I wasn't (he / she / it)
chunks.pt: eu estava (era) / eu não estava (não era)
chunks.tip: WAS é o passado de am e is. Serve pra I, he, she e it. Negativo: wasn't (was not). E em português pode ser "estava", "era" ou "foi": it was me = fui eu!

chunks.chunk: you were / you weren't / Where were you? (we / they)
chunks.pt: você estava / você não estava / Onde você estava?
chunks.tip: WERE é o passado de are: you, we, they. Pra perguntar, o were vai pra frente: Were you at home? Resposta curtinha: Yes, I was. / No, I wasn't.
examples: Were you at home? Yes, I was.

practice.pt: Vocês estavam na festa? Sim, estávamos.
practice.en: Were you at the party? Yes, we were

chunks.chunk: there was / there were / So who was it?
chunks.pt: tinha (havia) um… / tinha (havia) vários… / Então quem foi?
chunks.tip: Lembra do there is / there are? No passado vira there was (uma coisa) e there were (várias). E "So who was it?" é a pergunta de detetive da fofoca!
examples: Last night, there was a party in apartment 101.
There were 20 people in your apartment!

practice.en: There was a party in apartment 12
There were 30 people at the party
alt: There were thirty people at the party

practice.pt: Então quem foi? Foi o Max!
practice.en: So who was it? It was Max!

grammar.title: Como funciona
rows: I was / he was / she was / it was
eu estava / ele estava / ela estava / estava
you were / we were / they were
você estava / nós estávamos / eles estavam
eu não estava / ela não estava
você não estava / eles não estavam
Was he at home? Yes, he was.
Ele estava em casa? Sim, estava.
Were you there? No, I wasn't.
Você estava lá? Não, não estava.
There was a party. / There were 20 people.
last night / yesterday / two days ago / in 2020
ontem à noite / ontem / dois dias atrás / em 2020
grammar.tip: Regra de ouro: am e is viram WAS; are vira WERE. Só isso! E a resposta curta é a cara do nativo: Yes, I was. / No, they weren't.

gossips.title: The Missing Cake

lines.text: It's Monday. Yesterday, there was a cake on Rosa's table. At 5 PM, it was there. At 6, it wasn't!
Lily! Sam! Where were you at 5?
I was in my room. And Max was here too!
Max? Was he in the kitchen?
Yes, he was. He was under the table.
Rosa looks at Max. His face is brown.
Mom, **to be honest**… it wasn't only Max. I was there too. We were a team!
Now Sam is cleaning the kitchen. And Max? He's sleeping, very happy.

options: The cake wasn't on the table at 6
Sam tells the truth: he and Max were a team
Under the table in the kitchen

retell.prompt: Reconte a fofoca com as suas palavras. Comece com: "The story is about…"

gossips.title: Tony, the Rock Star

lines.text: It's Thursday, 8 PM. Tony and Jenny are in front of the building.
**You know**, in 2010 I was a rock star! I was very famous.
Really? Were you in a band?
Yes, I was. We were on TV!
Carlos is laughing.
That's not true! You weren't a rock star. You were a waiter at the Rock Café.
The Rock Café? Where is it?
Go straight ahead for two blocks and turn left. It's on Main Street, across from Joe's.
OK… I was a waiter. But the music was great!

options: Tony says he was a rock star
Carlos tells the truth: Tony was a waiter
On Main Street, across from Joe's

realtimes.title: O mistério da cozinha
realtimes.pt: Ontem foi sábado, dia 21 de novembro. Tinha um cachorro na cozinha da Rosa às 11 da noite. Era o Max? Não, o Max estava em casa com o Carlos. A Jenny estava no hospital. O Tony estava na cama. Então quem era? Pra ser sincero, era o cachorro do vizinho novo, do apartamento 15!
realtimes.model: Yesterday was Saturday, November 21st. There was a dog in Rosa's kitchen at 11 PM. Was it Max? No, Max was at home with Carlos. Jenny was at the hospital. Tony was in bed. So who was it? To be honest, it was the new neighbor's dog, from apartment 15!

realtimes.title: Quando eu era criança
realtimes.pt: Em 2015, eu tinha 8 anos. Minha escola ficava ao lado da minha casa. Minha professora era a Mrs. Silva; ela era muito legal. Meus amigos eram engraçados, mas eles não eram bons alunos. E eu? Pra ser sincero, eu não era um bom aluno. Eu estava sempre na janela!
realtimes.model: In 2015, I was 8 years old. My school was next to my house. My teacher was Mrs. Silva; she was very nice. My friends were funny, but they weren't good students. And me? To be honest, I wasn't a good student. I was always at the window!
